paragraphs: Ulla bar Ilai, before Rav Naḥman. Rav Ulla son of Rav Ilai, Shabbat 129a; Yoma 35; Beitzah 22a; Bava Kamma 7a; Zevaḥim 11b. He had a case before Rav Naḥman; Rav Yosef wrote that Ulla our colleague was a fellow in Torah and commandments, Shevuot 30a.
